policy: The current camera recommendation catalog covers cameras a person directly operates handheld, on a tripod, or in a camera rig, where body or fixed-lens choice and ordinary size, weight, viewing, power and lens-system comparisons inform a purchase. Remotely operated robotic/PTZ installation systems require a separate decision model and are deferred, even if they use an interchangeable mount or appear in a Sony consumer gallery.

entries.reason: A remotely operated pan/tilt/zoom full-frame production camera intended for networked or installed operation. Its controller, installation, power, and remote-operation choices are central to purchase decisions; ordinary handheld camera body/weight/viewfinder comparisons do not represent that system.
entries.reconsideration: Reassess when the service offers a professional remote/PTZ purchase flow with control, installation, network, power and system-cost comparisons; review Sony's then-current identity and specifications before ingestion.
